note: Inputs for scripts/opportunity_rank.py. Facts come from niches.json, consumables.json and research/models-2026-11-19 (each with its own label and source). Judged points carry a reason. Checked 2026-11-19.

setup_usd.label: ASSUMED: Shopify $1 intro, domain, business phone line, logo, first month of apps; excludes liability insurance some suppliers require

refund_damage_pct_ltl.label: ASSUMED (LTL damage about 1.2% plus returns; system_and_mechanics.md)

conversion_by_aov.label: ASSUMED within secondary-source range 0.3-1.5%, lower for >$3,000 (system_and_mechanics.md); a new store's real rate is UNKNOWN

margin_if_unknown_pct.label: ASSUMED conservative floor where no dealer margin was found

infrared-sauna.why: Golden Designs/Dynamic likely accept online dealers; LTL freight, 240V on large units, health-claim temptation; same SKUs at Costco and Wayfair

barrel-sauna.why: Dundalk non-showroom tier 25%; 800-1,500 lb kits, fire and permit risk, long assembly

cold-plunge.why: No dealer program found for major brands; highest CPC; Costco pushing prices down; water plus electricity

golf-simulator.why: Rain or Shine and Shop Indoor Golf work with online resellers; parcel shipping; big specialist dealers dominate; SkyTrak refuses dropship

home-gym.why: Top garage-gym brands DTC only (REP says no); injury liability; heavy returns

massage-chair.why: Osaki/Titan run a dropship model (2012 source, confirm); plug-in; 25% restocking terms; brand service reputation weak

hot-tub-swim-spa.why: Local territory dealers, hardwiring, site prep, drowning risk; not workable online-only

standing-desk-ergo-chair.why: Parcel, low risk, Dhruv knows the buyer; dealer access UNKNOWN; Amazon flooded with cheap desks

pizza-oven.why: Ooni dealer form exists; parcel; low ticket for this model; frequent brand sales

outdoor-kitchen-grill.why: Authorized-dealer gating; gas install; BBQGuys dominates; off season

pergola-outdoor-furniture.why: Install crews required for premium; permits; off season (Dec/Jan index 0.59)

e-bike.why: Brands DTC-first; lithium battery fire risk, CPSC rule pending; Rad Power bankruptcy

espresso-machine.why: Entrenched specialists; service-heavy; repeat sales of beans and parts possible

electric-fireplace.why: Parcel, plug-in, strongest Dec/Jan (1.67); dealer terms UNKNOWN; big-box competition; 38-40% figure is dated so 30% used

portable-power-station.why: Brands discount DTC constantly; lithium dangerous goods

fire-pit-table.why: Many small dealers carry OGC; gas fittings; off season
